questions.scenario: Under the shared responsibility model, which of these is ALWAYS the customer's responsibility regardless of the service used?
options: Customer data and who can access it
questions.explain: Customer data, its classification, its encryption and access to it are always the customer's responsibility on every service. Physical security, the hypervisor and the network are always AWS's.

questions.scenario: Which service tracks configuration changes to AWS resources over time?
questions.explain: Config records what state a resource is in and how that changed over time. CloudTrail records who made the change. The pair is commonly confused: Config = what it looks like, CloudTrail = who did it.

questions.scenario: Which database service is a fully managed relational database supporting PostgreSQL and MySQL?
questions.explain: RDS is the managed relational database service supporting engines including PostgreSQL and MySQL. DynamoDB is NoSQL, Neptune is a graph database, and DocumentDB is MongoDB-compatible.

questions.scenario: Which service is a managed data warehouse for running analytics over large datasets?
questions.explain: Redshift is AWS's data warehouse for large-scale analytics. RDS serves transactional relational workloads, ElastiCache is an in-memory cache, and Athena queries data directly in S3.

questions.scenario: Which statement BEST describes the difference between scalability and elasticity?
options: Scalability is the ability to grow; elasticity is automatic growing and shrinking with demand
questions.explain: Scalability is the capacity to grow. Elasticity adds the automatic contraction when demand falls — which is why questions mentioning scaling down point to elasticity.

questions.scenario: A company wants to reduce its carbon footprint from cloud workloads. Which Well-Architected pillar applies?
questions.explain: Sustainability covers environmental impact including energy consumption and carbon footprint. Cost Optimization concerns money, which often correlates but is a different pillar.

questions.scenario: Which AWS Support plan provides NO technical support, only billing and account assistance?
questions.explain: Basic Support is free and includes billing and account questions, documentation, forums and core Trusted Advisor checks, but no technical support. Any question requiring technical support rules Basic out.

questions.scenario: Which two Savings Plans types does AWS offer, and which provides the most flexibility?
options: Compute Savings Plans, which apply across EC2, Fargate and Lambda
EC2 Instance Savings Plans, which apply to any service
Storage Savings Plans, which apply to S3
Network Savings Plans, which apply to data transfer
questions.explain: Compute Savings Plans are the most flexible, applying across EC2, Fargate and Lambda regardless of instance family or Region, at up to 66% off. EC2 Instance Savings Plans give a bigger discount (up to 72%) but are tied to one instance family in one Region.

questions.scenario: Which component of a VPC allows resources in a private subnet to reach the internet for updates without being reachable from the internet?
questions.explain: A NAT gateway lets private-subnet resources make outbound connections while remaining unreachable from the internet. An internet gateway provides two-way connectivity for public subnets.

questions.scenario: Which statement correctly distinguishes a security group from a network ACL?
options: Security groups are stateful and operate at the instance level; network ACLs are stateless and operate at the subnet level
Security groups are stateless; network ACLs are stateful
Both operate at the subnet level
Security groups support deny rules; network ACLs do not
questions.explain: Security groups guard the instance, are stateful (return traffic is automatically allowed) and support allow rules only. Network ACLs guard the subnet, are stateless, and support both allow and deny rules.

questions.scenario: Which service provides and manages SSL/TLS certificates for use with AWS services at no cost?
questions.explain: ACM provisions and renews SSL/TLS certificates for AWS services free of charge. KMS manages encryption keys, CloudHSM provides dedicated hardware modules, and Secrets Manager stores credentials.

questions.scenario: Which service creates and controls the encryption keys used to encrypt data across AWS services?
questions.explain: KMS creates and manages encryption keys and integrates with most AWS services. Artifact supplies compliance reports, Macie finds sensitive data, and Config tracks configuration.

questions.scenario: Which is an example of a capital expense (CapEx) rather than an operational expense (OpEx)?
options: Purchasing physical servers for a data centre
Paying per GB of S3 storage used
questions.explain: Buying physical servers is a large up-front capital expense. All the AWS examples are usage-based operational expenses, which is precisely the trade cloud offers.

questions.scenario: Which service should be used to run a simple website with a predictable low monthly price and minimal configuration?
questions.explain: Lightsail bundles compute, storage and networking at a fixed monthly price for simple workloads. EC2 offers far more control but more configuration, and Fargate and EKS are container services.

questions.scenario: Which feature allows S3 objects to move automatically to cheaper storage classes as they age?
questions.explain: Lifecycle policies transition objects to cheaper classes or expire them on a schedule. Versioning retains previous copies, Transfer Acceleration speeds uploads, and Block Public Access prevents public exposure.

questions.scenario: Which TWO services help a company analyse data already stored in Amazon S3?
questions.explain: Athena runs SQL queries directly against data in S3, and QuickSight builds dashboards and visualisations from it. EBS is block storage, Direct Connect is private connectivity, and Route 53 is DNS.

questions.scenario: Which AWS service provides a single dashboard aggregating security findings from multiple security services?
questions.explain: Security Hub aggregates findings from services such as GuardDuty, Inspector and Macie into one view. Detective investigates the root cause of an issue, and Firewall Manager manages firewall rules centrally.

questions.scenario: What does 'economies of scale' mean in the context of AWS pricing?
options: AWS's large purchasing volume lowers costs, and those savings are passed to customers
Customers must commit to three-year terms
Larger instances always cost less per hour
questions.explain: Because AWS buys hardware and capacity at enormous volume, its per-unit costs fall and those savings reach customers as lower prices. It is one of the six standard cloud benefits.

questions.scenario: Which service would you use to migrate a database to AWS with minimal downtime?
questions.explain: DMS migrates databases to AWS while the source stays operational, minimising downtime. Snowball moves bulk data physically, RDS is the destination service, and Glue performs ETL.

questions.scenario: A company wants to grant a partner temporary access to a specific S3 bucket without creating a permanent user. What should it use?
options: An IAM role assumed by the partner
questions.explain: An IAM role grants temporary, scoped access without permanent credentials — the correct pattern for third parties. Sharing root credentials or a user password violates least privilege, and a public bucket exposes data to everyone.
